resources.string: Local long-press menu and saved-video export

Off by default. Re-enter a video after enabling. On recognized offline entries, long-press the video while playing or paused for local actions; Toki may translate online or fetch missing subtitle data when connected, and reads existing caches when disconnected. Only the explicit local-data-only option prohibits these remote requests. Save already-downloaded videos to the gallery without downloading them again. Complete native files keep their original audio/video timing; supported separate tracks can be combined into one video. The saved file is checked before it appears in the gallery. Missing, encrypted, incomplete or unsupported tracks are not downloaded or repaired. The menu also opens this account’s saved comments with cached-translation toggles; optional per-comment online translation can save results; explicit first/next comment-page loading can also save snapshots; per-root reply pages can also be cached; full native-comment-button replacement and a local translation model are not yet included.

Offline video comment button opens cached comments

Off by default and independent of the long-press menu. After enabling, re-enter the video. On the inspected 47.6.3 ordinary comment-button path, only the currently selected offline video opens Toki’s cached-comment window. Online videos, stale/hidden/unmatched components and unsupported code keep native behavior. The original comment button must already be visible; this does not unhide it or replace every native layout. Cached viewing starts locally; online pages/translations still require explicit actions.
